result.instructions: Tools for Kantata, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which workspaces are open in Kantata, and when is each one due?"; "Show me my open tasks due this week."; "Log 90 minutes on the onboarding task for yesterday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kantata data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kantata_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kantata_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kantata_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kantata_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kantata_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the Kantata OX user that the token belongs to, with name, email, role and account membership. Good first call to confirm the connection. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: kantata_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users visible to the token, optionally filtered by a search string. Use the returned user ids in other tools. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: kantata_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List client and partner organizations visible to the token. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/organizations.

type.description: Organization type as Kantata OX stores it (for example, a client type).

tools.name: kantata_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces (projects) visible to the token, with title, dates, status and participants. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/workspaces.

tools.name: kantata_get_workspace
tools.title: Get a workspace
tools.description: Get one workspace (project) by id, with title, dates, budget fields and participants. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}.

tools.name: kantata_list_stories
tools.title: List stories (tasks)
tools.description: List stories (tasks) with title, status, due date, assignees and completion. Filter by workspace, assignee, completion or due dates. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/stories.

workspace_id.description: Only stories in this workspace id.

assigned_to_current_user.description: true = only stories assigned to the token's user.

due_after.description: Only stories due after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

due_before.description: Only stories due before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

updated_after.description: Only stories updated after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: kantata_get_story
tools.title: Get a story (task)
tools.description: Get one story (task) by id, with its description, dates, assignees, status and checklist. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/stories/{id}.

tools.name: kantata_create_story
tools.title: Create a story (task)
tools.description: Create a story (task) in a workspace. Writes data: creates a new task each call. Kantata API: POST /api/v1/stories.

parent_id.description: Parent story id, to make this a subtask.

tools.name: kantata_update_story
tools.title: Update a story (task)
tools.description: Change the title, description or dates of an existing story (task). Only the fields you pass change. Writes data. Kantata API: PUT /api/v1/stories/{id}.

tools.name: kantata_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List logged time entries with minutes, date performed, user, story and billable flag. Filter by workspace, user or date range. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/time_entries.

workspace_id.description: Only entries in this workspace id.

created_by.description: Only entries created by this user id.

on_my_account.description: true = only entries on the token's account.

date_performed_between.description: Work dates from and to, as yyyy-mm-dd:yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: kantata_list_timesheet_submissions
tools.title: List timesheet submissions
tools.description: List timesheet submissions with their status and period, filtered by workspace, user or dates. Kantata API: GET /api/v1/timesheet_submissions.

workspace_id.description: Only submissions in this workspace id.

statuses.description: Comma-separated submission statuses as Kantata OX stores them.

tools.name: kantata_log_time
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: Log a time entry against a workspace, optionally a story. Writes data: creates a new entry each call, so do not retry it blindly. Kantata API: POST /api/v1/time_entries.

date_performed.description: The date the work was done (yyyy-mm-dd).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Kantata
prompts.description: What you can do with Kantata here, with example requests to try.
